title: Canto 6: Prescribed Duties for Mankind - Title, Artist and Source Pictures Canto 6
content:
Title, Artist and Source Pictures Canto 6

6.1

Title: The painting is titled “Cheater”.

Artist: Vlad Holst, used with permission

Source: Ten Dreams.org

6.2

Title: The image is titled: “The death of the good old man”.

Artist: William Blake

Type: Object 14 of illustrations to Robert Blair's, ' The Grave’.

Source: William Blake Archive. blakearchive.org

6.3

Title: The painting is titled: ‘The Court of Yamārāja’.

Artist: © Dominique Amendola, used with permission

Source: for more of her spiritual art of her making, visit dominiqueamendola.com

6.4

Title: Digitally processed vintage Hindu poster from Kathmandu, Nepal.

Source: Internet.

6.5

Title: The picture is an artist impression of Āryabhatha, the famous Indian mathematician and astronomer teaching us about the concept of zero, the number pi and the roundness of the earth around 476 CE.

Type: The picture is taken from a book cover in a series called 'Rishi Scientists of India’, Sharelike © License.

Source: veda.wikidot.com

6.6

Title: The picture shows a Buddhist mandala of Chandra (Soma), late 14th–early 15th century Nepal.

Source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art

6.7

Title: The picture shows Brihaspati, the divine sage and tutor of the gods.

Source: Goloka.com

6.8

Title: The painting of Krishna is titled 'Raman playing the flute’.

Artist: © Dominique Amendola, used with permission

Source: for more of her spiritual art of her making, visit dominiqueamendola.com

6.9

Title: Painting of Vishnu.

Artist: B.K. Mitra

Source: Unknown

6.10

Title: The picture shows Indra carrying his weapons riding on his elephant.

Artist: Unknown

Source: Internet

6.11

Title: The picture is titled 'Lord Indra riding the Airavat, the eight trunked elephant’.

Artist: Unknown

Source: © 1996-2004, Kamat’s Potpourri - Kamat.com. All rights Reserved

6.12

Title: The relief shows Lord Indra on his elephant in battle, raising his thunderbolt.

Artist: Unknown

Source: The Hare Kṛṣṇas, harekrsna.com

6.13

Title: The picture shows Lord Caitanya, demonstrating the grace of chanting the holy name with the animals.

Artist: Unknown

Source: Krishna Darshan Art Gallery

6.14

Title: The painting is titled: 'The Bird Simurgh Addresses an Assembly of Animals’.

Artist: Kailash Raj

Source: © Exoticindia.com, used with permission

6.15

Title: The picture of Nārada is a detail of a painting titled: 'Shri Krishna Radha Stuti by Jaideva (Gita Govinda Series)’.

Artist: Unknown

Source: © Exoticindia.com, used with permission

6.16

Title: Illustration 1 shows Krishna saving us from the waves.

Artist: B.K. Mitra

Source: The Hare Kṛṣṇas, Harekrsna.com)

6.17

Title (wrongfully): “Lord Shiva awaiting Tripura to join with each other”.

Artist: Unknown

Source: © Exoticindia.com, used with permission

6.18

Title: Stone relief of a love scene of an eastern couple.

Artist: Unknown

Source: The Hare Kṛṣṇas, harekrsna.com

6.19

Title: Popular Hindu image of the divine couple of Vishnu and Lakshmī.

Artist: Unknown

Source: Internet
